tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[The parabolic ball stays inside $B(y,t_0,\epsilon )$] For $\delta $ sufficiently small (how small depending on $\delta _2$ and $\delta '_2$) we have $B(z,t',\epsilon /4)\subset B(y,t_0,\epsilon )$. \end{claim}

Proof

\sketch Since $|t_0-t'|<\delta \le \delta _2$, and by construction $\delta _2<\delta _0$, it follows that for any $c\in B(y,t_0,\epsilon )$ we have $d_{t'}(b,c)\le 2d_{t_0}(b,c)$. Since $d_{t_0}(y,b)<\delta \le \epsilon /4$, the result is immediate from the triangle inequality.

□
